story: Stage 3 of the Baloise Belgium Tour 2026 featured an early breakaway of five riders, quickly caught. Multiple attacks in the finale were reeled in, with Rick Pluimers leading into the last climb. He was caught in the final kilometer. Alex Aranburu won the steep finish, ahead of Lewis Askey and Carlos Canal, becoming the new overall leader.
